notes.title: Halloween Update Event!
notes.content:
The NicoNotes Whoo have been busy getting ready for Halloween, play along with them in these special Halloween theme levels. New update for the game. Collect candy, change costumes, join the Monster Party!
11 new Halloween theme levels.

1 – Candy Road
2 - Ghost Town
3 – Monster Party
4 – Pumpkin Patch
5 – Sticky Swamp
6 – Cemetery
7 – Escape
8 - Crystal Caves
9 – Mad Scientist Lab
10 – Castle Friends
11 – Halloween Party
